# Lab 02 hints

<details><summary>Hint 1 — Determinism requires a tie-break</summary>

Sort on a pair: negative relevance and article ID. Do not rely on original order when relevance is equal.

</details>

<details><summary>Hint 2 — Skip is different from stop</summary>

An article that is too large should trigger `continue`, not terminate the loop. A shorter later passage may fit.

</details>

<details><summary>Hint 3 — Track three pieces of state</summary>

Maintain selected IDs, a set of IDs already visited, and used character count. Mark an ID visited before the fit check so duplicate records cannot choose a different version later.

</details>
